card.name: Words just before lab threshold numbers
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right before a numeric lab or dose threshold, such as 'less than', 'between', 'within' or a decimal point. Seen in dose-adjustment rules and trial statistics.

modes.label: Comparison words before a limit
modes.description: Words like 'than', 'and' or 'within' that come just before a lab cutoff value.

modes.label: Decimal point in statistics
modes.description: The point inside a number in confidence intervals or ratios.

modes.description: A space or bracket that comes right before the next number or abbreviation.
